policy.policy: Freeze the training winner before evaluating the remaining eight UUID-sorted cards per color. No fitting on validation or per-card scan re-registration. Retain current defaults for rejected candidates.
policy.secondaryMetric: Fixed reference-disc ink masks at three thresholds; do not normalize ink bounds. Geometry fit combines 60% whole-cost edge overlap with 40% glyph overlap.

sets.policy: First twelve accepted nonlegendary cards per rightmost mana color, UUID sorted; first four fit, remaining eight reserved. Fixed independently fitted scan-frame pose; no per-symbol scan alignment. Same controls across each set.
